revisions.summary: Initial specification. Defines the file header, tile table and metadata blocks; the universal block header and its recovery tags; the array and byte-array primitives; layer extents and tile offsets; attributes, associated images, ICC colour profiles and annotations. Establishes little-endian dense packing, the derived-offset rule, and the append-only versioning invariant.

Adds focal-plane support (PLANES on the layer extent entry, MICRONS_PLANE spacing), a configurable tile edge length (TILE_LENGTH), an optional self-describing tile frame, a clinical metadata block reached by a new METADATA offset, carrying a stream whose serialization -- HL7 v2, FHIR as JSON, or FastFHIR -- is declared by an ENCODING field rather than inferred from the bytes, and redefines METADATA_I2S as Iris Interoperability Specification conformance. The two metadata channels divide by shape as well as by subject: laboratory metadata is key-value and stays in the attribute arrays under I2S or DICOM, while the clinical resource graph goes in the stream. Only the stream carries identity, so a slide is de-identified by dropping it alone.
